event_summary: A white textured sheet moves downward into a shallow dish of blue liquid, disturbs the liquid surface, then folds and becomes mostly covered by the liquid.
raw_event_description: At the start, a shallow white dish containing light-blue liquid sits on a wooden tabletop while a white textured sheet hangs above it, with part of an orange-and-black object visible near the top of the frame. After a long still interval, the sheet moves downward into the dish. Its lower edge reaches the blue liquid, the liquid surface shows splashes and ripples, and the sheet bends from a vertical hanging form into a folded shape. Over the later frames, the sheet lies flatter in the dish, with less white area visible above the blue surface and a faint rectangular sheet outline visible under the liquid.

reasons: A shallow white dish containing blue liquid is clearly visible on the tabletop.
A white textured sheet is visible above the dish.
The orange-and-black upper object is partly cropped by the top edge of the frame.
